corrected_value.authors: Uchida M. Biederman J. Gabrieli J. D. E. Micco J. de Los Angeles C. Brown A. .
corrected_value.title: Emotion regulation ability varies in relation to intrinsic functional brain architecture

decisions.quote: This investigation is inspired by the study of Uchida et al. ( 2015 ). Because there are important differences concerning the operationalization of the constructs and the experimental procedure between our study and the Uchida study (see Supplementary Table S24 ), the current investigation can be a conceptual replication at best.
decisions.reason: In Aim 2 (Introduction, Methods, Results Table 3, and Discussion), the authors explicitly perform a preregistered conceptual replication of Uchida et al. (2015) in N = 107 healthy adults, re-testing whether task-related experiential reappraisal success correlates negatively with resting-state functional connectivity (rsFC) between the amygdala and prefrontal cortex (mPFC/dmPFC/vmPFC/dlPFC) and concluding in the Discussion that the findings of Uchida et al. (2015) could not conceptually be replicated. The reference list verifies the exact identity of Uchida et al. (2015) in Soc. Cogn. Affect. Neurosci. 10, 1738–1748, DOI 10.1093/scan/nsv059. The sole shipped row (input_row_index 2488) is Picó-Pérez et al. (2017/2018) (DOI 10.1007/s11682-017-9762-3), which is the Aim 1 target investigating self-reported dispositional ERQ scores rather than task-based experiential reappraisal success; report equivalence does not apply. No prior adjudication file existed for this work.
